summary: Frontend-only testing of 4 new features on Galista Café vitrine (loader 3D CSS, hero text 'La pause istanbulienne', reviews carousel 1/10, enriched menu ingredients) + regressions. All targeted tests passed on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844.

test_results.loader: PASS — [data-testid=loader] visible immediately on fresh context, body overflow=hidden (scroll locked), disappears within ~2.6s, does NOT reappear on same-session reload (sessionStorage galista-loader-seen works).
test_results.reviews_carousel: PASS — single figure rendered, counter starts at '1 / 10', next→'2/10', prev→'1/10', prev from 1 loops to '10/10', dot-4 jumps to '5/10', 10 dots total, drag-left advances counter (5→6).
test_results.carte_ingredients: PASS — 14 cafes items each show rich descriptive sentence (e.g. 'Un espresso intense et velouté, extrait avec soin pour révéler une crema dense...') under INGRÉDIENTS label; i18n switches language.
test_results.regressions: PASS — nav-link-carte present, open badge present, no horizontal overflow desktop 1440 or mobile 390, mobile action bar present.
test_results.console: No React/framer-motion errors. Only a pre-existing MapLibre worker warning ('Worker failed to load. Check that the worker URL is correct.') from the map chunk — unrelated to the 4 new features. Also one framer-motion scroll-offset informational warning about non-static container (benign).

action_items: (Optional / pre-existing) Investigate MapLibre worker URL warning in #contact map — not blocking visually; the map still renders. Could be CSP / worker path issue in the chunked bundle.
critical_code_review_comments: Loader session-gating uses sessionStorage key 'galista-loader-seen' — works as designed; good UX.
Carousel prev-from-first correctly loops to 10/10 and swipe threshold ~60px feels right.
Ingredient descriptions are coherent, 1-2 sentence style, consistent across the sampled items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loader only shows once per session (sessionStorage). Use a fresh/incognito context to retest. All data-testids used: loader, lang-switcher-fr/de/en, review-carousel, review-prev, review-next, review-counter, review-dot-{0..9}, nav-link-carte, category-filter-cafes, menu-item-*. MapLibre worker console error is pre-existing noise.
